items.title: OpenAI和Anthropic表現定生死！《大賣空》真實主角示警：AI榮景存在致命弱點
items.title_en: OpenAI and Anthropic Performance Determines Life or Death! The Real Protagonist of “The Big Short” Warns: AI Boom Has a Fatal Weakness
paras: 華爾街知名投資人艾斯曼(Steve Eisman)最新警告，本輪人工智慧熱潮如今愈發依賴兩家企業的發展命運：OpenAI與Anthropic。艾斯曼現在也是播客《艾斯曼真實投資法則》主持人，此前曾任紐伯格伯曼高級投資組合經理。
這位因全球金融危機前夕押注做空美國房市而聲名大噪的投資人周二(11日)向《CNBC》表示，微軟、亞馬遜、谷歌及甲骨文四家科技巨頭，他們的AI相關營收中約七成均來自上述兩家AI新創公司，OpenAI與Anthropic貢獻的營收佔四家雲端運算業務總收入的比重更達到25%至35%。
艾斯曼說：「某種意義上來說，這些科技巨頭的未來發展，本質上都是在押注OpenAI和Anthropic能夠最終走向成功。」
艾斯曼同時擔任播客《艾斯曼真實投資法則》主持人，此前曾任紐伯格伯曼高級投資組合經理。
艾斯曼指出，AI產業營收面臨的最大潛在威脅來自價格有顯著優勢的開源AI模式。
他說：「整輪AI行情的致命弱點在此。若Anthropic和OpenAI遭遇重大挫折，局面就會生變。一些開源大模型、開放權重模型成本要低廉得多。根據我多方了解，它們已開始大舉搶佔市場份額，屆時行業大概率會爆發激烈競爭。」
目前，市場圍繞AI熱潮天量投入能否兌現充足投資回報的爭論愈演愈烈，艾斯曼此番表態，為這場論戰又增添一位重量級發聲者。
好萊塢電影《大賣空》本尊Michael Burry觀點更為悲觀。他質疑，當下及未來絕大部分AI需求並非終端用戶真實剛需，很大一部分需求源自其口中的循環融資模式。
Burry已經用真金白銀實踐自身判斷，他對輝達等本輪AI浪潮最大受益企業押下空頭賭注，同時披露自身針對半導體大盤的空頭持倉。
paras_en: Wall Street veteran investor Steve Eisman recently warned that the current AI frenzy is increasingly dependent on the fortunes of two companies: OpenAI and Anthropic. Eisman, who now hosts the podcast “Eisman Real Investment Rules,” previously served as a senior portfolio manager at Neuberger Berman.

The investor, who rose to fame by shorting the U.S. housing market on the eve of the global financial crisis, told CNBC on Tuesday (the 11th) that roughly 70% of AI‑related revenue for the four tech giants—Microsoft, Amazon, Google and Oracle—comes from the two AI startups, and that OpenAI and Anthropic account for 25% to 35% of the total cloud‑computing revenue of those firms.
Eisman said, “In a sense, the future development of these tech giants is fundamentally a bet on OpenAI and Anthropic ultimately succeeding.”
Eisman also hosts the podcast “Eisman Real Investment Rules” and previously worked as a senior portfolio manager at Neuberger Berman.
Eisman pointed out that the biggest potential threat to AI‑industry revenue comes from open‑source AI models that have a significant price advantage.

He added, “The fatal weakness of the whole AI rally lies here. If Anthropic and OpenAI suffer a major setback, the landscape will change. Open‑source large models and weight‑open models are far cheaper to run. From what I’ve gathered, they are already aggressively taking market share, and the industry is likely to erupt into fierce competition.”
The debate over whether the massive capital flowing into the AI hype can deliver sufficient returns is intensifying, and Eisman’s comments add another heavyweight voice to the discussion.

Hollywood’s “The Big Short” protagonist Michael Burry is even more pessimistic. He questions whether most current and future AI demand is genuine end‑user need, arguing that a large portion of demand stems from the financing‑by‑circulation model he describes.

Burry has put his conviction into action with real money, shorting Nvidia and other companies that stand to benefit most from the current AI wave, and has disclosed his short positions against the broader semiconductor market.

items.title: IPO前怎麼了？OpenAI數日內連走兩名重量級高層
items.title_en: What Happened Before the IPO? OpenAI Loses Two Heavyweight Executives Within Days
paras: OpenAI高層人事再度震盪。該公司周四(13日)宣布，去年12月才加入的營收長Denise Dresser將在任職不到一年後離職，尋求其他發展機會，並由Google母公司Alphabet旗下資安公司Wiz總裁暨營運長Dali Rajic接任。這也是OpenAI短短數日內第二名重量級主管出走，正值公司籌備首次公開募股(IPO)及企業市場競爭升溫之際，格外引發關注。
Dresser將在短暫過渡期內留任，協助業務團隊服務客戶，並與OpenAI總裁Greg Brockman合作完成交接。她在LinkedIn發文表示，能親身參與全球最具變革性的科技令人難以置信，也為團隊取得的成果及彼此支持感到驕傲。
Dresser曾任Slack執行長，並在Salesforce(CRM-US)擔任主管超過十年，去年底受聘領導OpenAI營收業務。她具備公司亟需的企業軟體及客戶開發經驗，原被寄望協助OpenAI擴大企業市場、抗衡主要競爭對手Anthropic。今年4月，資深主管Brad Lightcap轉任負責「特殊專案」後，Dresser還接手其部分職責。
不過，Lightcap本周稍早也宣布，在效力OpenAI八年後離職創業。此前，產品及業務主管Fidji Simo因慢性病嚴重惡化，於上月辭去職務；前產品長Kevin Weil則在4月離開。連串人事異動使新任營收長Rajic成為Brockman擴大管理權限後，首批重要主管任命之一。
Brockman表示，AI技術的部署方式正快速改變，Rajic將把公司累積的經驗轉化為可重複執行的營運模式。他在內部備忘錄指出，OpenAI年化營收在7月較前月成長逾20%，其中企業客戶業務成長32%。公司認為，下一階段必須更專注證明客戶投入的每一美元，都能帶來可衡量的商業效益。
Rajic擅長建立以客戶及數據指標為核心的組織，其資安背景也被視為重要優勢，因企業在導入能力更強的AI模型時，日益重視網路攻擊與防禦風險。
OpenAI正與Anthropic激烈爭奪企業客戶。Anthropic憑藉程式設計等複雜任務工具快速崛起，今年稍早估值首度超越OpenAI，並可能最快於今秋率先掛牌。OpenAI則持續推廣包括程式設計工具Codex在內的AI代理，並調降部分模型價格，以對抗Anthropic及中國競爭對手。
OpenAI已於6月向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)祕密遞交IPO文件，3月募資估值高達8,520億美元。隨著公司準備迎接華爾街檢驗，如何穩定管理團隊、維持高速成長並證明企業AI業務的獲利潛力，將成為投資人關注焦點。
paras_en: OpenAI’s senior leadership is shaking up again. The company announced on Thursday (the 13th) that Denise Dresser, who joined as chief revenue officer in December last year, will leave after less than a year to pursue other opportunities, and will be succeeded by Dali Rajic, president and COO of Wiz, a security firm owned by Alphabet. This marks the second heavyweight executive to depart within a few days, drawing extra attention as the firm prepares for its first public offering and faces intensifying competition in the enterprise market.

Dresser will stay on for a brief transition period to help the sales team serve customers and work with OpenAI president Greg Brockman on the handover. In a LinkedIn post she said it has been incredible to be part of the world’s most transformative technology and she is proud of the team’s achievements and mutual support.

Dresser previously served as Slack’s CEO and spent more than a decade in leadership roles at Salesforce (CRM‑US). She was hired at the end of last year to lead OpenAI’s revenue business, bringing the enterprise‑software and customer‑development experience the company urgently needs, and was expected to help expand the enterprise market and counter the main rival Anthropic. In April, senior executive Brad Lightcap moved to head “special projects,” and Dresser took over some of his responsibilities.

However, Lightcap also announced earlier this week that after eight years at OpenAI he is leaving to start his own venture. Earlier, product and business head Fidji Simo resigned last month due to a severe chronic illness, and former chief product officer Kevin Weil left in April. The string of departures makes Rajic, the new CRO, one of the first key appointments after Brockman expanded his management authority.

Brockman said the way AI technology is deployed is changing rapidly, and Rajic will turn the company’s accumulated experience into a repeatable operating model. In an internal memo he noted that OpenAI’s annualized revenue grew more than 20% in July versus the prior month, with enterprise revenue up 32%. The company believes the next stage must focus on proving that every dollar a customer invests yields measurable commercial benefit.

Rajic is skilled at building organizations centered on customer and data metrics, and his cybersecurity background is seen as a major advantage as enterprises adopting more powerful AI models become increasingly concerned about cyber‑attack and defense risks.

OpenAI is locked in a fierce battle with Anthropic for enterprise customers. Anthropic has risen quickly with tools for complex tasks such as programming, and earlier this year its valuation briefly surpassed OpenAI’s, with a possible IPO as early as this fall. OpenAI continues to promote AI agents including the coding tool Codex and has lowered prices on some models to counter Anthropic and Chinese competitors.

OpenAI secretly filed its IPO paperwork with the U.S. SEC in June, after a March fundraising that valued the company at $852 billion. As the firm prepares for Wall Street scrutiny, stabilizing the management team, sustaining rapid growth, and proving the profitability potential of its enterprise AI business will be key concerns for investors.

items.title: 川普逼車廠回美國代價多大？三巨頭每年恐多燒20億美元
items.title_en: How Much Will Trump’s Push for Car Makers to Return to the U.S. Cost? The Big Three Could Face Up to $2 Billion Extra Per Year
paras: 《路透》周四(13日)報導，美國底特律三大車廠準備向川普政府提出警告，華府研議中的北美自由貿易協定調整方案，可能讓每家車廠每年增加至少20億美元成本，不僅加重現有關稅負擔，更可能削弱美國業者與日、韓及歐洲車廠競爭的能力。
美國汽車業者仍在消化川普政府去年陸續加徵的鋼鋁、汽車零組件，以及從墨西哥和加拿大進口整車關稅。如今，美方在下月與墨西哥官員展開新一輪談判前提出更嚴格的原產地規則，進一步引發通用汽車(GM-US)、福特(F-US)及Jeep母公司Stellantis(STLA-US)憂慮。

美國製造門檻擬升至50% 每家車廠恐多花20億美元

最具爭議的提案，是要求汽車至少含有50%的美國製零組件，才能享有較低關稅待遇。華府還考慮把北美地區製造內容門檻，從目前的75%進一步提高。根據兩家車廠內部估算，這兩項要求可能使每家底特律車廠每年增加至少20億美元支出，而且還不包括既有關稅造成的成本。
通用汽車預估，今年關稅相關總支出將達25億至35億美元，可能吃掉逾20%的營業利益；福特則估計，今年關稅造成的淨衝擊約為10億美元。美國貿易代表署(USTR)未回應置評請求，川普政府官員過去則表示，關稅政策旨在促使企業增加美國工廠投資並創造就業。
為展現擴大美國製造的承諾，福特周三宣布，將把供應美國市場的Lincoln車款生產線從中國移至美國工廠，並坦言川普政府的關稅是主要推力。
福特執行長法利(Jim Farley)表示，公司起初可能低估川普政府提高美國汽車產量的決心，但很快便意識到必須調整策略。福特目前在美國銷售的車輛中，本土生產占比原本就高於底特律其他競爭對手。
美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)表示，希望更多車廠仿效福特與通用汽車，將生產工作移回美國，並稱政府與業者已共同努力，尋找合適的政策方向。
美國與墨西哥官員預計下月舉行第四輪貿易談判；加拿大官員本周也正與美方協商，希望避免美國針對加拿大的新一輪關稅於下周生效。

日韓歐車廠僅付15%關稅 底特律業者喊不公平

代表福特、通用汽車與Stellantis的美國汽車政策委員會(AAPC)指出，美國車廠正處於不利地位，因為從日本、南韓及歐洲出口至美國的車輛只須支付15%的統一關稅。
相較之下，美國車廠目前從墨西哥與加拿大進口汽車，面臨約25%的關稅，僅美國製造內容占比較高的車輛能獲得較低稅負。由於底特律三大車廠的供應鏈長期橫跨美、墨、加三國，更嚴格的原產地規則可能迫使業者重組供應鏈、調整生產配置，進而推高車輛成本。
通用汽車執行長巴拉(Mary Barra)先前表示，公司正致力確保美國車廠在面對歐洲、日本及南韓業者的關稅待遇時，仍能公平競爭並取得勝利。
一名美國汽車業主管指出，川普能較快與南韓及日本達成協議，是因為兩國政府可在涉及國家安全的廣泛貿易談判中，代表本國汽車業爭取利益；美國車廠卻缺乏相同籌碼，沒有總統或總理能代為直接向川普交涉。
通用汽車表示，使用大量美國及北美製零組件的車輛，理應比未採用相關零組件的汽車獲得更優惠待遇，並對政府談判進展感到鼓舞。Stellantis也表示，正與美國、墨西哥及加拿大政府合作，確保業者仍能在北美生產及銷售消費者負擔得起的汽車。
底特律車廠支持強化美國製造，卻擔心政策若一次大幅提高原產地門檻，將讓已承受數十億美元關稅成本的業者雪上加霜。在亞洲與歐洲競爭對手享有較低關稅之際，川普政府若無法平衡本土生產目標與車廠成本，最終代價也可能轉嫁給美國消費者。
paras_en: Reuters reported on Thursday the three major Detroit automakers are preparing to warn the Trump administration that the proposed adjustments to the North American Free Trade Agreement could add at least $2 billion in annual costs for each company, not only increasing existing tariff burdens but also potentially weakening U.S. firms’ ability to compete with Japanese, Korean and European manufacturers.

U.S. auto makers are still absorbing tariffs imposed last year by the Trump administration on steel, aluminum, auto parts and on fully built vehicles imported from Mexico and Canada. Now, ahead of a new round of talks with Mexican officials next month, Washington is proposing stricter rules of origin, sparking concern at General Motors (GM‑US), Ford (F‑US) and Jeep parent Stellantis (STLA‑US).

The most contentious proposal would require cars to contain at least 50% U.S.-made components to qualify for lower tariffs. Washington is also considering raising the regional content threshold from the current 75%. Internal estimates from the two automakers suggest these requirements could increase each Detroit automaker’s annual expenses by at least $2 billion, not counting costs already driven by existing tariffs.

General Motors estimates its total tariff‑related outlay this year will reach $2.5‑$3.5 billion, potentially eroding more than 20% of operating profit; Ford puts its net tariff impact at about $1 billion for the year. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office declined to comment, while Trump officials have said the tariff policy is meant to spur investment in U.S. plants and create jobs.

To demonstrate its commitment to expanding U.S. manufacturing, Ford announced on Wednesday that it will shift the production line for Lincoln models supplied to the U.S. market from China to a U.S. plant, stating that Trump‑era tariffs are the main driver of the move.

Ford CEO Jim Farley said the company may have initially underestimated the Trump administration’s resolve to boost U.S. auto output, but quickly realized a strategic shift was necessary. He noted that a higher share of Ford’s U.S. sales already comes from domestically produced vehicles compared with other Detroit rivals.

U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said he hopes more automakers will follow Ford and GM in moving production back to the United States, adding that the government and industry have been working together to find the right policy direction.

U.S. and Mexican officials expect to hold a fourth round of trade talks next month; Canadian officials are also negotiating with Washington this week to try to prevent a new round of U.S. tariffs on Canada from taking effect next week.

The American Automotive Policy Committee (AAPC), representing Ford, GM and Stellantis, warned that U.S. automakers are at a disadvantage because cars imported from Japan, South Korea and Europe face a uniform 15% tariff.

By contrast, U.S. automakers importing vehicles from Mexico and Canada face roughly a 25% tariff, with only those cars that have a high U.S. content qualifying for lower duties. Because the Detroit three‑way supply chain spans the U.S., Mexico and Canada, stricter rules of origin could force a reshuffle of supply chains and production footprints, pushing vehicle costs higher.

GM chief Mary Barra has previously said the company is working to ensure U.S. automakers can compete fairly and win against European, Japanese and South Korean rivals despite the tariff differentials.

An industry executive noted that Trump was able to reach agreements with South Korea and Japan quickly because those governments could represent their domestic auto sectors in broad security‑related trade talks, whereas U.S. automakers lack a comparable bargaining chip and no president or prime minister can negotiate directly with Trump on their behalf.

GM said vehicles that use a large share of U.S. and North‑American parts should merit more favorable treatment than those that do not, and welcomed progress in the negotiations. Stellantis also said it is working with the U.S., Mexican and Canadian governments to keep North‑American production and affordable pricing for consumers.

Detroit automakers support stronger U.S. manufacturing but warn that a sudden, large increase in the rules‑of‑origin threshold would add to the billions of dollars already spent on tariffs, making the burden heavier. With Asian and European rivals enjoying lower duties, a failure by the Trump administration to balance domestic‑production goals with automaker costs could ultimately shift the price burden onto American consumers.

items.title: 關稅退款神速！標普500逾40家申報96億美元 蘋果近22億美元入袋
items.title_en: Tariff Refunds Speedy! Over 40 S&P 500 Companies Report $9.6 Billion, Apple Bags Nearly $2.2 Billion
paras: 隨著美國大型企業陸續收到關稅退款，部分企業的獲利因此大幅獲得提振。
儘管外界曾警告關稅退款流程可能「緩慢且混亂」，但許多企業似乎正以驚人的速度拿回款項：標普500指數成分股企業中，目前已有超過40家申報過去一季收到總計約96億美元的關稅退款，其中至少21億美元是實際收到的現金。
目前已公布的最大筆退款包括：蘋果(AAPL-US)近22億美元，Nike(NKE-US)9.86億美元，聯邦快遞(FedEx)(FDX-US)約8億美元，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)6.4億美元，以及通用汽車(GM-US)5億美元。
截至7月31日，美國海關與邊境保護局(CBP)涉及最高法院裁定違法的關稅退款申請超過25.2萬件。該機構官員上周告訴聯邦法院，CBP已受理總額達1287億美元的退款申請需要處理。
多家公司表示，已經收到所申請的全部退款，或是預期很快就能收到。例如Nike表示，截至5月31日止的會計年度最後一季，已收到3.02億美元退款，等到7月15日發布年度股東報告時，幾乎已收到剩餘的6.84億美元。
其他企業則明確表示，部分退款申請仍在等待結果。工業測量設備及自動化技術製造商Fortive針對已收到的關稅退款認列450萬美元利益，預期未來一段時間裡還可再獲得最高2500萬美元退款。
這些已經由企業申報的退款金額，不一定代表現金已經入帳。各家公司在財報上的處理方式也有所不同，有些企業只有在實際收到現金後才認列，但也有一些企業會把預期可收到的款項一併反映在財報中。
條碼掃描器及印表機製造商斑馬科技(Zebra Technologies)(ZBRA-US)在第2季判斷，過去支付的7,300萬美元關稅很可能全部獲得退款。截至7月4日為止一季結束時，該公司已收到1400萬美元現金，其餘款項則列為應收款。截至7月31日，公司表示又收到2700萬美元退款。
在部分企業中，關稅退款已對單季業績產生顯著貢獻。蘋果表示，關稅退款使上季每股獲利增加11美分，約占該季每股獲利的5%。
GE醫療科技(GE HealthCare Technologies)則表示，在6月30日為止一季裡，每股獲利1.24美元當中，有18美分來自關稅退款。該公司表示已收到1.07億美元退稅款，預期還會再收到3800萬美元。
然而，對許多企業而言，即使關稅退款帶來可觀利益，仍然和持續支付的關稅兩鄉抵銷。
工程機械大廠開拓重工(Caterpillar)(CAT-US)最近一季認列預期可追回的退稅金額為3.92億美元，但表示今年剩餘時間的財測並未納入進一步的退款。該公司預期全年關稅支出總額將達22億美元，這尚未扣除可追回的關稅款。
到目前為止，科技硬體業申報的退款金額最高，約六家企業合計達25億美元，其中近90%來自蘋果。
逾12家資本財企業申報約13億美元退款，包括重型設備製造商開拓重工及強鹿(Deere)(DE-US)的2.72億美元，國防承包商洛克希德馬丁(Lockheed Martin)(LMT-US)六個月內獲得的1.4億美元，以及工具製造商史丹利百得(Stanley Black & Decker)(SWK-US)的1.18億美元。
多家公司表示，將把退款部分轉還給客戶，例如聯邦快遞將從8月開始把8億美元退款退還給託運客戶及消費者。
聯邦快遞表示，該公司在關稅及稅款方面扮演代收代付的角色，依法必須向客戶收取相關費用，其客戶可透過聯邦快遞網站追蹤退稅進度。
好市多(Costco)(COST-US)則是眾多遭尋求退款消費者提起集體訴訟的企業之一。該公司表示，正計劃以「某種形式」將關稅退款轉還給客戶，金額水準將與過去轉嫁給客戶的關稅成本相近。不過該公司表示，聯邦退款流程本身可能需要數個月。
銷售泵浦及閥門、服務多個產業的IDEX表示，預期將向客戶退還1470萬美元，約占已收到逾2000萬美元退款的三分之二。
部分企業則未明確說明預期追回款項的來源。福特汽車(Ford Motor)(F-US)表示，預期將從聯邦政府及供應商合計獲得約30億美元關稅補償，其中約13億美元來自最高法院裁定川普政府緊急關稅無效的決定。
亞馬遜表示，已判定出「有限的情況」，可以追溯由客戶承擔的關稅成本，等收到退款現金後，將聯繫這些客戶並退還款項。
paras_en: As large U.S. companies begin receiving tariff refunds, some see a sharp boost to earnings.

Although observers warned that the tariff‑refund process could be "slow and chaotic," many firms appear to be getting money back at a remarkable pace: among S&P 500 constituents, more than 40 have reported receiving about $9.6 billion in refunds for the last quarter, at least $2.1 billion of which has been received in cash.

The biggest refunds disclosed so far include: Apple (AAPL‑US) close to $2.2 billion, Nike (NKE‑US) $986 million, FedEx (FDX‑US) about $800 million, Amazon (AMZN‑US) $640 million, and General Motors (GM‑US) $500 million.

As of July 31, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) had more than 252,000 tariff‑refund applications deemed illegal by the Supreme Court. CBP officials told a federal court last week that it has accepted refund requests totaling $128.7 billion that still need processing.

Several companies say they have already received the full refunds they applied for, or expect to get them soon. Nike, for example, said that for the fiscal quarter ending May 31 it had received $302 million in refunds and that by the time it releases its annual shareholder report on July 15 it will have almost the remaining $684 million.

Other firms are more explicit that some refund claims remain pending. Industrial measurement and automation maker Fortive recorded a $4.5 million benefit from refunds already received and expects to obtain up to $25 million more in the coming period.

These company‑reported refund amounts do not necessarily mean cash has been booked. Accounting treatment varies: some firms only recognize refunds when cash is actually received, while others also reflect expected receivables in their statements.

Barcode scanner and printer maker Zebra Technologies (ZBRA‑US) judged in Q2 that the $73 million in tariffs it paid were likely to be fully refunded. By the end of the quarter on July 4 the company had received $14 million in cash, with the balance recorded as a receivable, and by July 31 it said it had received another $27 million refund.

In some companies, tariff refunds have made a noticeable contribution to quarterly performance. Apple said the refunds added 11 cents to earnings per share last quarter, roughly 5% of that quarter’s EPS.
GE HealthCare Technologies said that of its $1.24 EPS for the quarter ended June 30, $0.18 came from tariff refunds. The company has received $107 million in refunds and expects another $38 million.
However, for many firms, even sizable refund gains are largely offset by ongoing tariff payments.

Caterpillar (CAT‑US) recognized an expected $392 million in recoverable refunds this quarter but said its financial outlook for the rest of the year does not include additional refunds. The company expects total tariff spending of $2.2 billion for the year, before subtracting any recoverable amounts.
To date, the technology‑hardware sector has reported the highest refund totals, about $2.5 billion across six companies, nearly 90% of which comes from Apple.

More than 12 capital‑goods firms have reported roughly $1.3 billion in refunds, including Caterpillar and Deere (DE‑US) with $272 million, defense contractor Lockheed Martin (LMT‑US) with $140 million earned over six months, and tool maker Stanley Black & Decker (SWK‑US) with $118 million.
Several companies say they will pass a portion of the refunds back to customers, for example FedEx will start returning $800 million in refunds to shippers and consumers beginning in August.
FedEx explained that it acts as an intermediary for tariffs and taxes, legally must collect the fees from customers, and that customers can track the refund progress on FedEx’s website.

Costco (COST‑US) is among the many firms facing class‑action lawsuits from consumers seeking refunds. Costco said it plans to return tariff refunds to customers in “some form,” at an amount roughly comparable to the tariff costs previously passed on, though it warned the federal refund process could take several months.
Industrial pump and valve maker IDEX said it expects to return $14.7 million to customers, about two‑thirds of the more than $20 million it has already received in refunds.

Some firms did not specify the source of expected recoveries. Ford Motor (F‑US) said it expects about $3 billion in tariff compensation from the federal government and suppliers, including roughly $1.3 billion stemming from the Supreme Court’s ruling that the Trump administration’s emergency tariffs were invalid.
Amazon said it has identified limited situations where it can recoup tariff costs borne by customers; after receiving cash refunds it will contact those customers and reimburse them.

items.title: 延攬國際人才！金融就業金卡核發破千張 香港、美國成最大來源地
items.title_en: Taiwan Attracts International Talent: Financial Employment Gold Card Issuance Exceeds 1,000
paras: 為響應政府積極延攬外國專業人才政策並促進國內金融產業發展，金管會推動「金融領域就業金卡」再傳捷報，自2018年實施至今，金融領域就業金卡累計核發已正式突破千張大關，達到 1,005 張，約占全體就業金卡總數的 6%。其中，香港與美國為最主要的外國人才來源地。
金管會表示，為配合「亞洲資產管理中心」的政策目標，金管會於去(2025)年底修正認定原則，將「資產管理(含聯合家族辦公室)」正式列入重點產業項目。政策效應隨之顯現，今年截至 6 月底已核發 92 張金融金卡，較去年同期的 71 張大幅成長近 3 成。
金管會參與審查的金融領域就業金卡累計已核發1,005張，約占全體核發金卡總數17,365張之6%；其中，香港278張、美國229張、新加坡129張、加拿大72張、英國69張，為金融領域持卡人的前五大來源國家或地區。
金管會國際業務處處長賴銘賢補充，若觀察近年核發趨勢，2023 年核發 110 張、2024 年為 151 張、2025 年為 145 張。而今年截至 7 月底，核發量已達 113 張，依目前年化成長速度預估，今年整體核發表現極具潛力，很有機會突破以往紀錄。
至於歷史最高峰則落在 2021 年的 198 張。賴銘賢解釋，當時主因是處於疫情期間，台灣邊境管制嚴格，而持有就業金卡者可不受邊境限制，相關優勢在國際專業人才圈內口碑相傳，進而帶動該年申請量暴增，並非單一金融政策觸動。
賴銘賢說明，金融金卡申請人的專業涵蓋銀行、證券、保險及資產管理等各領域。然而，就業金卡目的在於提供具「四證合一(工作許可、居留簽證、外僑居留證及重入國許可)」的便利性，持卡人在 1 至 3 年有效期內可自由尋職與轉職。
賴銘賢說，「即使以金融領域申請進來，政府並不會限制他後續只能在金融業任職。」舉例來說，若持卡人後續轉往科技業(如台積電)從事內部財務或金融管理相關工作，均完全符合規定，整體制度設計目的在於吸引各類優質人才落腳台灣。
金管會整理數據後發現，持卡人多集中於香港、美國、新加坡等五大區域，其中不乏具華裔背景者，普遍認為台灣生活便利且發展機會多。至於日常生活或居住適應等相關配套，政府也會透過國發會「就業金卡辦公室」提供全方位協助。
paras_en: To respond to the government's active policy of attracting foreign professional talent and promoting the development of the domestic financial industry, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) has made another breakthrough in the 'Financial Employment Gold Card' program, with a total of 1,005 cards issued since its implementation in 2018, accounting for about 6% of the total number of employment gold cards issued. Among them, Hong Kong and the United States are the main sources of foreign talent.

The FSC stated that in order to comply with the policy goal of 'Asian Asset Management Center', the FSC revised the recognition principle at the end of 2025 and officially listed 'asset management (including joint family offices)' as a key industry project. The policy effect has been shown, with 92 financial gold cards issued as of June 30 this year, a significant increase of nearly 30% compared to the same period last year.

The FSC has issued a total of 1,005 financial employment gold cards, accounting for about 6% of the total number of gold cards issued, 17,365. Among them, Hong Kong has 278, the United States has 229, Singapore has 129, Canada has 72, and the United Kingdom has 69, ranking as the top five countries or regions of origin for financial employment gold card holders.

FSC International Business Department Director Lai Ming-xian added that if we observe the trend of issuance in recent years, 110 cards were issued in 2023, 151 in 2024, and 145 in 2025. As of July 31 this year, the number of cards issued has reached 113, and based on the current annual growth rate, the overall performance of card issuance this year is expected to be very promising and may break the previous record.

As for the historical peak, it was in 2021 with 198 cards. Lai Ming-xian explained that at the time, the main reason was that during the pandemic period, Taiwan's border controls were strict, and holders of employment gold cards were not subject to border restrictions. The related advantages were well-known in the international professional talent circle, which led to a surge in applications that year, not just a single financial policy.

Lai Ming-xian explained that the professionals applying for financial gold cards cover banking, securities, insurance, and asset management, among other fields. However, the purpose of the employment gold card is to provide a convenient 'four-in-one' (work permit, residence permit, foreign residence permit, and re-entry permit) service, allowing cardholders to freely seek and change jobs within 1-3 years.

Lai Ming-xian said, 'Even if they apply for financial employment, the government will not restrict them from working in other industries afterwards.' For example, if a cardholder later transfers to the technology industry (such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company) to work in internal finance or financial management, it is completely in line with the regulations, and the overall system design is to attract high-quality talents to settle in Taiwan.

After analyzing the data, the FSC found that cardholders are concentrated in Hong Kong, the United States, Singapore, and other five major regions, including those with a Chinese background. They generally believe that Taiwan has a convenient lifestyle and many development opportunities. The government will also provide comprehensive assistance through the National Development Council's 'Employment Gold Card Office' for daily life and residence adaptation, etc.

items.title: 費半指數強彈進入牛市  分析師卻警告：AI巨額積壓訂單≠已經到手的收入
items.title_en: Semiconductor Index Surges into Bull Market, Analysts Warn: AI Backlog ≠ Revenue
paras: 美股半導體族群周三(12日)全線飆升，費城半導體指數收於12399.38點，距離從近期低點反彈20%的「技術性牛市」門檻12536.99點僅差約1.1%。
漲直接催化劑來自CoreWeave、美超微(Super Micro)、Lumentum三家中下游AI基礎設施廠周二(11日)盤後公布的財報：CoreWeave將全年資本支出指引從310-350億美元上調至350-390億美元，積壓訂單達1040億美元、7月初再添逾250億美元客戶承諾；美超微重申6月當季新訂單破600億美元；Lumentum受惠1.6T光模組與AI資料中心光互連，上季營收翻倍。
但Portfolio Thinking創辦人Dan Kemp認為，積壓訂單是「簽約未確認收入」，部分可取消或延期，應當成機率分佈，而非落袋營收。
他以CoreWeave為例，該公司Q2淨利息支出6.4億美元，調整後營業利益僅1.28億美元，債務總額350億美元，「還沒看到足夠的消費與企業端支出，支撐這種規模資本承諾」。
Zacks投資管理公司首席市場策略師Brian Mulberry則相對正面，認為AI交易「正變得更廣泛而不只是更大」，CoreWeave驗證GPU需求、Lumentum驗證配套光網路，輝達、博通、Coherent基本面最紮實，但也強調並非所有晶片廠同享紅利，市場已從看「價格動能」轉向看「增長是否加速」。
費半指數雖距牛市只差臨門一腳，但關鍵問題已從「AI需求存不存在」轉向「需求增速能否兌付股價隱含預期」，1040億美元積壓訂單很好，但6.4億利息vs1.28億營業利益的差距則提醒市場，在訂單到利潤之間，還隔著電力、液冷、交期與利率四道關卡。
paras_en: The US semiconductor sector surged on Wednesday, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index closing at 12,399.38, just 1.1% shy of the 20% technical bull market threshold of 12,536.99.

The rally was driven by strong earnings from CoreWeave, Super Micro (SMCI), and Lumentum, three companies in the downstream AI infrastructure supply chain. CoreWeave raised its full-year capital expenditure guidance to $3.5-3.9 billion from $3.1-3.5 billion, with backlog orders reaching $10.4 billion, and adding over $2.5 billion in new customer commitments in early July. Super Micro reiterated that its new orders in the second quarter exceeded $6 billion, while Lumentum benefited from its 1.6T optical module and AI data center interconnect business, with its quarterly revenue doubling.

However, Portfolio Thinking founder Dan Kemp cautioned that backlog orders are 'unconfirmed revenue,' with some potentially cancelable or delayed, and should be viewed as a probability distribution rather than actual revenue.

He cited CoreWeave as an example, which reported $640 million in net interest expense in Q2, with adjusted operating income of just $128 million. With $3.5 billion in debt, Kemp noted that 'we haven't seen enough consumption and enterprise spending to support this scale of capital commitments.'

Zacks Investment Management chief market strategist Brian Mulberry took a more positive view, saying that AI trading is 'becoming more widespread, not just bigger.' CoreWeave validated GPU demand, while Lumentum validated the need for optical networking. He also highlighted the strong fundamentals of companies like Taiwan Semiconductor, Broadcom, and Coherent, but emphasized that not all chipmakers will benefit equally, and that the market is shifting from focusing on 'price momentum' to 'whether growth is accelerating.'

While the semiconductor index is just a hair's breadth away from bull market territory, the key question has shifted from 'does AI demand exist' to 'can demand growth deliver on implied stock price expectations.' The $10.4 billion backlog order is impressive, but the $640 million in interest expense versus $128 million in operating income highlights the challenges in converting backlog into actual revenue, with power, cooling, lead times, and interest rates all posing hurdles.

items.title: 金管會查核會計師事務所 今年6件防洗錢缺失遭罰65萬元
items.title_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission Fines 6 Accounting Firms NT$650,000 for AML Failures
paras: 為因應亞太防制洗錢組織(APG)第五輪相互評鑑，加上國際洗錢手法日益複雜，金管會已加強對非金融業「專家角色」的洗錢防制監理。金管會證期局表示，先前針對27家會計師事務所進行現地檢查時，發現多項洗錢防制執行缺失，至今已對6家違規的個人會計師事務所開罰，總計裁罰金額新台幣65萬元。
金管會證期局副局長黃仲豪指出，洗錢防制規範不限於金融機構，包括會計師、律師等非金融事業人員亦在規管範圍內。考量我國預計於2030年迎來APG實地評鑑，金管會特別提醒會計師，在為客戶提供公司登記、資本額查核簽證或管理資產、不動產買賣等服務時，必須嚴格執行客戶盡職調查(CDD)與疑似洗錢交易申報(STR)，切勿成為不法集團洗錢的破口。
金管會說明，先前會商會計師公會針對27家會計師事務所(包含簽證公開發行公司的中大型事務所及小型事務所)進行現地檢查，發現缺失主要樣態包括未對客戶及案件進行風險評估；未瞭解客戶之所有權及控制權結構；未辨識及驗證客戶之實質受益人；對高風險客戶未採取加強審查措施；未評估疑似洗錢交易之情形；未於現地檢查時提供完整工作底稿；未確實執行客戶身分確認措施並保存相關資料。
以及未於確認客戶身分時利用外部資料庫或資訊來源確認客戶及其實質受益人是否為現任或曾任國內外政府或國際組織之重要政治性職務人士，亦未注意是否屬法務部公告之制裁名單等。
針對檢查發現的缺失，黃仲豪表示，金管會今年已陸續依《洗錢防制法》進行行政處分，法定罰鍰為5萬至500萬元。目前已處理完畢的案件共計6件，均為「個人會計師事務所」，裁罰總金額為65萬元，其中單筆最高罰鍰為25萬元。相關處分均已依法公告。
為協助會計師提升辨識能力，金管會已責成會計師公會檢討並修正「疑似洗錢或資恐交易態樣」。例如：客戶資金來源異常、或是突然出現與收入不符的奢華生活方式等，均列入態樣分析範疇。
此外，金管會也搭配每年至少3小時的強制教育訓練與宣導活動，並強調未來將持續採「風險基礎方法(RBA)」每年辦理洗錢防制檢查，針對高風險事務所及常犯缺失加強查核，若有違規將依法嚴懲，以提升我國整體洗錢防制制度的韌性。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) has strengthened its anti-money laundering (AML) oversight of non-financial institutions, including accounting firms, in response to the increasing complexity of money laundering methods and the upcoming mutual evaluation by the Asia-Pacific Group (APG) in 2030.

FSC's Securities and Futures Bureau Deputy Director-General Huang Zhong-hao emphasized that AML regulations are not limited to financial institutions, but also apply to professionals such as accountants, lawyers, and other non-financial business personnel.

The FSC conducted on-site inspections of 27 accounting firms, including large and small firms, and found several AML execution deficiencies. The FSC has since fined six individual accounting firms a total of NT$650,000 for violating AML regulations.

The FSC pointed out that the AML deficiencies found in the inspections included failure to conduct customer due diligence (CDD) and suspicious transaction reporting (STR), failure to understand customer ownership and control structures, and failure to identify and verify beneficial owners.

The FSC also found that some accounting firms failed to conduct risk assessments on customers and cases, failed to evaluate suspicious transactions, and failed to provide complete working documents during on-site inspections.

The FSC has instructed the Accounting Profession Association to review and revise the guidelines for identifying suspicious transactions, including unusual customer funding sources or lavish lifestyles that do not match income.

The FSC will continue to conduct AML inspections using the risk-based approach (RBA) and will strengthen checks on high-risk firms and those that frequently commit AML deficiencies. Firms that violate AML regulations will be punished in accordance with the law to enhance Taiwan's overall AML system.

items.title: 延攬國際人才！金融就業金卡核發破千張 香港、美國成最大來源地
items.title_en: Taiwan Attracts International Talent: Financial Employment Gold Card Issuance Exceeds 1,000
paras: 為響應政府積極延攬外國專業人才政策並促進國內金融產業發展，金管會推動「金融領域就業金卡」再傳捷報，自2018年實施至今，金融領域就業金卡累計核發已正式突破千張大關，達到 1,005 張，約占全體就業金卡總數的 6%。其中，香港與美國為最主要的外國人才來源地。
金管會表示，為配合「亞洲資產管理中心」的政策目標，金管會於去(2025)年底修正認定原則，將「資產管理(含聯合家族辦公室)」正式列入重點產業項目。政策效應隨之顯現，今年截至 6 月底已核發 92 張金融金卡，較去年同期的 71 張大幅成長近 3 成。
金管會參與審查的金融領域就業金卡累計已核發1,005張，約占全體核發金卡總數17,365張之6%；其中，香港278張、美國229張、新加坡129張、加拿大72張、英國69張，為金融領域持卡人的前五大來源國家或地區。
金管會國際業務處處長賴銘賢補充，若觀察近年核發趨勢，2023 年核發 110 張、2024 年為 151 張、2025 年為 145 張。而今年截至 7 月底，核發量已達 113 張，依目前年化成長速度預估，今年整體核發表現極具潛力，很有機會突破以往紀錄。
至於歷史最高峰則落在 2021 年的 198 張。賴銘賢解釋，當時主因是處於疫情期間，台灣邊境管制嚴格，而持有就業金卡者可不受邊境限制，相關優勢在國際專業人才圈內口碑相傳，進而帶動該年申請量暴增，並非單一金融政策觸動。
賴銘賢說明，金融金卡申請人的專業涵蓋銀行、證券、保險及資產管理等各領域。然而，就業金卡目的在於提供具「四證合一(工作許可、居留簽證、外僑居留證及重入國許可)」的便利性，持卡人在 1 至 3 年有效期內可自由尋職與轉職。
賴銘賢說，「即使以金融領域申請進來，政府並不會限制他後續只能在金融業任職。」舉例來說，若持卡人後續轉往科技業(如台積電)從事內部財務或金融管理相關工作，均完全符合規定，整體制度設計目的在於吸引各類優質人才落腳台灣。
金管會整理數據後發現，持卡人多集中於香港、美國、新加坡等五大區域，其中不乏具華裔背景者，普遍認為台灣生活便利且發展機會多。至於日常生活或居住適應等相關配套，政府也會透過國發會「就業金卡辦公室」提供全方位協助。
paras_en: To respond to the government's active policy of attracting foreign professional talent and promoting the development of the domestic financial industry, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) has made another breakthrough in the 'Financial Employment Gold Card' program, with a total of 1,005 cards issued since its implementation in 2018, accounting for about 6% of the total number of employment gold cards issued. Among them, Hong Kong and the United States are the main sources of foreign talent.

The FSC stated that in order to comply with the policy goal of 'Asian Asset Management Center', the FSC revised the recognition principle at the end of 2025 and officially listed 'asset management (including joint family offices)' as a key industry project. The policy effect has been shown, with 92 financial gold cards issued as of June 30 this year, a significant increase of nearly 30% compared to the same period last year.

The FSC has issued a total of 1,005 financial employment gold cards, accounting for about 6% of the total number of gold cards issued, 17,365. Among them, Hong Kong has 278, the United States has 229, Singapore has 129, Canada has 72, and the United Kingdom has 69, ranking as the top five countries or regions of origin for financial employment gold card holders.

FSC International Business Department Director Lai Ming-xian added that if we observe the trend of issuance in recent years, 110 cards were issued in 2023, 151 in 2024, and 145 in 2025. As of July 31 this year, the number of cards issued has reached 113, and based on the current annual growth rate, the overall performance of card issuance this year is expected to be very promising and may break the previous record.

As for the historical peak, it was in 2021 with 198 cards. Lai Ming-xian explained that at the time, the main reason was that during the pandemic period, Taiwan's border controls were strict, and holders of employment gold cards were not subject to border restrictions. The related advantages were well-known in the international professional talent circle, which led to a surge in applications that year, not just a single financial policy.

Lai Ming-xian explained that the professionals applying for financial gold cards cover banking, securities, insurance, and asset management, among other fields. However, the purpose of the employment gold card is to provide a convenient 'four-in-one' (work permit, residence permit, foreign residence permit, and re-entry permit) service, allowing cardholders to freely seek and change jobs within 1-3 years.

Lai Ming-xian said, 'Even if they apply for financial employment, the government will not restrict them from working in other industries afterwards.' For example, if a cardholder later transfers to the technology industry (such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company) to work in internal finance or financial management, it is completely in line with the regulations, and the overall system design is to attract high-quality talents to settle in Taiwan.

After analyzing the data, the FSC found that cardholders are concentrated in Hong Kong, the United States, Singapore, and other five major regions, including those with a Chinese background. They generally believe that Taiwan has a convenient lifestyle and many development opportunities. The government will also provide comprehensive assistance through the National Development Council's 'Employment Gold Card Office' for daily life and residence adaptation, etc.

items.title: 泰山要搶街口電支股權 街口金科反擊：拍賣程序極為遙遠
items.title_en: Taiwan Semiconductor to Bid for Street Voice's 100% Stake, Street Voice Fires Back
paras: 老牌食品廠泰山(1218-TW)13 日召開重訊記者會，宣布擬參與街口電子支付 100% 股權拍賣投標案。對此，街口金融科技隨即發表嚴正聲明強烈反擊，直指拍賣程序「極為遙遠」，控訴泰山刻意營造股權即將易手的假象，甚至質疑泰山「一面毀約、一面喊買」行為極不合常理，建請主管機關嚴查是否涉嫌操縱股價與內線交易。
針對泰山聲稱已假執行扣押街口電支 100% 股權並將參與拍賣，街口金融科技提出四大聲明，首先，強制執行程序須歷經扣押、鑑價、詢價、核定底價、公告及拍賣等繁複程序，目前僅完成扣押，且街口已依法提起救濟。泰山在拍賣根本未啟動前召開重訊，顯然是刻意製造假象，嚴重誤導投資人，恐涉嫌違反《證券交易法》第 155 條散布流言或不實資料之規定。
街口表示，雙方民事訴訟仍繫屬於臺灣高等法院審理中。此外，泰山現任董事長劉偉龍發起訴訟與假執行的代表權合法性，正由智財商業法院審理中。泰山據以扣押的假執行基礎在法律上有高度被撤銷風險，泰山明知有瑕疵卻強行推進，實有炒作股價之嫌。
街口強調，已採取全面司法救濟，在法院作成最終裁決前，街口電支的股權與控制權不受任何影響。作為國內電子支付龍頭，資金撥付、系統運作及用戶權益皆受金管會嚴格監管，絕不影響日常營運。
街口痛批，雙方原本簽有合法投資契約，泰山卻在訴訟中惡意毀約要求返還款項，如今又宣稱要透過拍賣買回，行為完全違背商業常理。街口嚴正呼籲金管會與證交所應密切監控泰山股價異動，嚴查是否有操縱股價等違反證券交易法之重大違法情事。
回顧這起爭議，泰山原投入約 36 億元投資街口金融科技，後因經營權爭議於 2023 年提起訴訟要求返還款項，並於 2025 年獲得法院一審判決得為假執行。泰山 13 日董事會通過參與拍賣投標案，授權投標金額以原投資本金 35.95 億元為上限，並計畫召開臨股會表決。
與此同時，泰山公布上半年財報由盈轉虧，稅後淨損達 7.87 億元，其中除了油安事件與中聯油脂虧損外，認列街口金融科技預付投資款減損高達 5.2 億元，亦是拖累業績的主因之一。
paras_en: Taiwan Semiconductor (1218-TW) held a press conference on the 13th, announcing its intention to participate in the auction of Street Voice's 100% stake in the electronic payment business. In response, Street Voice Financial Technology immediately issued a stern statement, strongly criticizing the auction process as 'extremely remote', accusing Taiwan Semiconductor of deliberately creating the illusion that the stake is about to change hands, and even questioning Taiwan Semiconductor's behavior of 'breaking the contract and then buying it' as extremely unreasonable.

Regarding Taiwan Semiconductor's claim that it has already executed a forced execution of Street Voice's 100% stake in the electronic payment business and plans to participate in the auction, Street Voice Financial Technology issued four statements. First, the forced execution process must go through a complex process of seizure, appraisal, inquiry, price determination, announcement, and auction, and currently only the seizure has been completed, and Street Voice has filed a lawsuit. Taiwan Semiconductor's press conference was clearly intended to create a false impression, seriously misleading investors, and may have violated Article 155 of the Securities and Exchange Act.

Street Voice emphasized that the civil lawsuit between the two parties is still being tried in the Taiwan High Court. In addition, the current chairman of Taiwan Semiconductor, Liu Wei-long, has initiated a lawsuit over the legitimacy of the representative rights of the forced execution, which is currently being tried in the Intellectual Property and Commercial Court. The basis for Taiwan Semiconductor's forced execution has a high risk of being revoked in law, and Taiwan Semiconductor is aware of the defects but has pushed forward, which is suspected of being a stock price manipulation.

Street Voice stressed that it has taken comprehensive judicial remedies, and before the court makes a final decision, the stock ownership and control rights of Street Voice's electronic payment business will not be affected. As the domestic electronic payment leader, the capital allocation, system operation, and user rights are all strictly regulated by the Financial Supervisory Commission, and will not affect daily operations.

Street Voice strongly criticized that the two parties had signed a legitimate investment contract, but Taiwan Semiconductor has maliciously broken the contract and demanded the return of the funds in the lawsuit, and now claims to buy it back through the auction, which is completely contrary to commercial common sense. Street Voice sternly urged the Financial Supervisory Commission and the Taiwan Stock Exchange to closely monitor Taiwan Semiconductor's stock price fluctuations and investigate whether there is any manipulation of stock prices or other major violations of the Securities and Exchange Act.

Looking back at this controversy, Taiwan Semiconductor originally invested around NT$36 billion in Street Voice Financial Technology, but due to disputes over operational rights, it initiated a lawsuit in 2023 to demand the return of the funds, and in 2025, it obtained a first-instance court judgment allowing the forced execution. On the 13th, Taiwan Semiconductor's board of directors passed a resolution to participate in the auction, authorizing the bidding amount to be up to the original investment principal of NT$35.95 billion, and plans to hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting to vote.

At the same time, Taiwan Semiconductor announced its first-half financial report, which turned from profit to loss, with a net loss of NT$7.87 billion, of which, in addition to the oil price event and the loss of Zhonglian Oil Fat, the recognition of Street Voice Financial Technology's prepaid investment loss was as high as NT$5.2 billion, which was one of the main factors dragging down the performance.

items.title: 財經名人假帳號氾濫！證交所澄清董座未設群組 提防AI變臉詐騙
items.title_en: Financial Bigwigs' Fake Accounts Rampant, TWSE Clarifies Chairman Has No Group, Beware of AI Scams
paras: 近年金融業董總及財經名人頻遭不肖人士冒名行騙，手法層出不窮。近期更有不法份子冒用臺灣證券交易所董事長名義，甚至利用 AI 深偽技術製作假影音，於 LINE 與 Facebook 等平台招攬投資群組。證交所鄭重澄清，董座及員工絕未成立任何群組或推介商品，提醒民眾務必提高警覺，切勿輕信，如有疑慮請立即洽詢證交所或撥打 165 反詐騙專線求證。
臺灣證券交易所近期發現，有不法人士於LINE、Facebook等社群平台及通訊軟體，冒用證交所董事長名義、照片，甚至利用人工智慧(AI)深偽技術製作影像或影音內容，發布投資訊息、招攬加入投資群組或推介金融商品，意圖誤導民眾並從事詐騙行為。
證交所鄭重聲明，證交所董事長從未建立或經營任何投資群組，亦未以個人名義設立Facebook粉絲專頁、LINE官方帳號或其他社群帳號從事投資招攬活動；證交所及所屬員工亦不會透過社群媒體、通訊軟體或投資群組向民眾推薦個股、招攬投資、保證獲利，或要求提供個人資料、帳戶資訊及匯款。
證交所呼籲，民眾如對涉及證交所或其員工之訊息真偽有任何疑問，可逕洽證交所投資人服務中心專線(02)2792-8188，或透過證交所民意信箱求證。若發現疑似詐騙情事，亦可檢具相關事證向警政署165反詐騙專線、165打詐儀錶板或警察機關檢舉，共同防範金融詐騙，維護自身財產安全。
paras_en: In recent years, financial industry leaders and celebrities have frequently been impersonated by scammers, with increasingly sophisticated methods. Recently, some lawbreakers have even used the name of the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) chairman, utilizing AI deepfake technology to produce fake videos and recruit investment groups on platforms like LINE and Facebook. The TWSE solemnly clarifies that the chairman and employees have never established any groups or promoted products, reminding the public to be vigilant and not to believe such claims easily. If in doubt, please contact the TWSE or call the 165 anti-scam hotline for verification.

The TWSE has recently discovered that some individuals have been using the chairman's name and photos on social media platforms and communication software, including LINE and Facebook, to release investment information, recruit investment groups, or promote financial products, with the intention of misleading the public and committing scams.

The TWSE solemnly declares that the chairman has never established or operated any investment groups, and has not set up Facebook fan pages, LINE official accounts, or other social media accounts for investment recruitment activities. The TWSE and its employees will not recommend individual stocks, recruit investments, guarantee profits, or request personal data, account information, or remittances through social media, communication software, or investment groups.

The TWSE urges the public that if they have any doubts about the authenticity of information related to the TWSE or its employees, they can contact the TWSE's Investor Service Center hotline (02)2792-8188 or submit an inquiry through the TWSE's opinion mailbox. If suspected scams are discovered, they can also provide relevant evidence to the National Police Agency's 165 anti-scam hotline, the 165 anti-scam dashboard, or the police authorities to report and jointly prevent financial scams, ensuring their own property safety.

items.title: 【東元法說會AI摘要】2026/08/13
items.title_en: [TECO Earnings Call AI Summary] 2026/08/13
paras:
一、東元(1504-TW)2026年第二季財務與營運詳情 

1. 2026 年第二季與上半年財務結果
第二季毛利率 達 25.1%(年增 1.6%、季增 1.6%)，主因電力能源事業群毛利提升貢獻；營業利益率達 10.5%(年增 1%、季增 2.2%)，重回兩位數，主要受惠於毛利率拉升及費用率明顯下降；每股盈餘 (EPS)達 1.12 元(年增 0.43 元、季增 0.61 元)。
上半年營業收入308 億 3,500 萬元(年增 5.5%)；毛利率 / 營利率： 毛利率 24.4%(年增 0.6%)；營業利益率 9.5%(年增 0.4%)；每股盈餘 (EPS)： 1.63 元(年增 32%)，反映本業營運改善與金融資產評價上升。
2.四大事業群表現 (Q2 & 上半年)
機電系統 (營收占比約 45%–46%)：Q2 營收 76 億(年增 12.9%)；上半年 139 億(年增 6%)。主要由大陸、台灣、北美及歐洲市場成長拉動。
電力能源 (營收占比約 25%–26%)：Q2 營收 43 億(年增 11.1%)；上半年 78 億(年增 20%)。成長主力為資料中心(Data Center)及離岸風電工程。
空調科技：Q2 營收年增 10.6%；上半年年減 11.6%(但專注於商業空調領域，上半年商用空調實現兩位數成長)。
能源機器系統 / 自動化：Q2 營收 90 億(年增 21%)；上半年 17 億(年增 15%)，主要得益於自動化產品貢獻增加。
註： 機電系統與電力能源兩大事業群合計已占公司整體營收 70% 以上。
3.三大主要市場趨勢
美國市場：CSP 業者資金持續投入，帶動電力相關需求。天然氣管道、基礎設施業者及資料中心需求大增，帶動大馬達需求，1-7 月取單量年增將近 30%。積極佈局變壓器、配電盤等電力設備，並於全球興建新廠以爭取訂單。
台灣市場：經濟部推動高用電戶診斷與節能計畫，帶動冰水主機、馬達汰換商機，以及 AI 智慧能源管理平臺需求。太陽能供電與儲能建置 1-7 月表現皆較去年同期成長。
東南亞市場：東南亞(特別是馬來西亞、泰國)資料中心(Data Center)市場持續成長，帶動 M&E(機電)相關工程與客製化解決方案商機。
4.四大策略重點與未來佈局
綠能與儲能：爭取風力二號離岸風電工程及台電深澳電廠專案；澳洲光儲案預計 Q4 完成安裝測試並開始貢獻營收；國產化 PCS 開始量產出貨；已建立 30 兆瓦(MW)綠電供電能量。
電氣化與電動車 (EV/無人機)：啟動印尼變壓器建廠計畫，爭取美國變壓器供應清單；協同印度客戶開發新型商用車電驅橋，並取得礦卡動力系統訂單；完成重載型無人機系統開發，已提供機器供美系客戶測試。
節能與產品線擴建：五期暖通廠積極進行建廠計畫，搶攻大型冰機商機。
重點區域與 Data Center：成立總裁直轄子公司，積極爭取石化產業及新環境商機。同時，佈局台灣、日本及東南亞 Data Center 市場；MDC(模組化資料中心)POC 預計於 Q4 完成建置。

【東元法說會問答完整清單(Q&A)】 

Q1：台灣政府實施「800kW 以上用電大戶」強制診斷政策，帶來多少商機？
回答：門檻從原先的 490 家大戶擴大至約 5,000 家用戶(涵蓋商場與中小型企業)，且具強制性。東元具備 ESCO 經驗，可結合「東訊」幫客戶做碳盤查、申報、診斷再到設備優化，並能拓展冰水主機、空壓機、水泵等節能設備汰換商機，將過去大戶的成功經驗向下複製。
Q2：空調事業群轉型狀況與商用空調(B2B)的展望為何？
回答：上半年整體空調衰退主要來自家用(B2C)市場，但高毛利的商用大型空調(B2B)營收實現兩位數成長(達 25% 以上)。東元專注於電子廠大型商用節能空調(節能可達 30%–40%)，提供多機鏈控與中央控制系統。大冷噸設備(最高至 1,600 噸)需求強勁，帶動產品結構改善與毛利率大幅提升，未來營收與獲利將持續向好。
Q3：美國大馬達 1 至 7 月取單年增將近 30%，主要驅動因素是什麼？
回答：美國 Tecco-Westinghouse 的大型空調客戶將設備轉用於 Data Center，導致中高壓大馬達需求突增且單量龐大，客戶均提前下單鎖定交期。另外，高油價刺激石油業者重新啟動開採，使 800 至 1,000 馬力的 HPOP 馬達需求呈暴增狀態。
Q4：綠電與售電業務的最新進展與市場供需狀況？
回答：已簽訂第一筆長期的綠電轉供大單(客戶為大型穩定採購戶)，第二筆台灣供應鏈大廠的訂單也即將敲定。針對市場現況，綠電市場目前呈現供不應求、單價節節高升的狀況。東元將加速協助台灣業者建置太陽能、儲能並進行轉供。
Q5：馬來西亞新廠(匯流排/Busway)的接單與出貨時程？
回答：7 月底已接獲第一筆訂單，預計 9 月底至 10 月開始出貨。工廠具備高自動化與雷射控制，塗裝與製程管線標準高於業界，能提供模組化產品，廣泛應用於 Data Center 與東南亞建廠需求。
Q6：MDC(模組化資料中心)POC 的驗證進度？
回答：目前進展順利，首個 2.7MW 的 MDC POC 設計已全部完成，建置地點位於馬來西亞，預計 9 月底至 10 月間完成建置，會是東元在 Data Center 領域非常重要的里程碑。
Q7：馬來西亞與泰國 Data Center 的整體工程優勢為何？
回答：雲端服務巨頭(CSP)最看重的是保證準時且高品質的交付能力。東元憑藉在馬來西亞團隊展現的良好執行力，成功贏得客戶信任，進而跟隨客戶腳步延伸至泰國及其他東南亞國家。
Q8：下半年整體營運與各事業群的毛利率展望？
回答：隨著高毛利的商用空調(B2B)、美國大馬達、東南亞 Data Center 匯流排及電氣化模組等產品陸續出貨，加上費用控管得宜，下半年整體毛利率將維持在與上半年相當或年增(YoY)的高水準。

paras_en: 1. TECO (1504-TW) Q2 2026 Financial and Operational Details

Q2 gross margin reached 25.1% (up 1.6% YoY and 1.6% QoQ), mainly due to higher margin in the Power & Energy business group; operating margin was 10.5% (up 1% YoY and 2.2% QoQ), returning to double‑digits thanks to margin expansion and a sharp drop in expense ratio; earnings per share (EPS) were NT$1.12 (up NT$0.43 YoY and NT$0.61 QoQ).

3. H1 revenue was NT$30.83 billion (up 5.5% YoY); gross margin / operating margin: gross margin 24.4% (up 0.6% YoY); operating margin 9.5% (up 0.4% YoY); EPS NT$1.63 (up 32% YoY), reflecting core‑business improvement and higher valuation of financial assets.
4. Performance of the four major business groups (Q2 & H1)

5. Electromechanical Systems (about 45‑46% of revenue): Q2 revenue NT$7.6 billion (up 12.9% YoY); H1 revenue NT$13.9 billion (up 6% YoY), driven by growth in Mainland China, Taiwan, North America and Europe markets.
6. Power & Energy (about 25‑26% of revenue): Q2 revenue NT$4.3 billion (up 11.1% YoY); H1 revenue NT$7.8 billion (up 20% YoY). Growth was led by data‑center and offshore wind projects.
7. Air‑Conditioning Technology: Q2 revenue grew 10.6% YoY; H1 revenue fell 11.6% YoY (but the segment focused on commercial air‑conditioning, which achieved double‑digit growth in the first half).
8. Energy Machinery Systems / Automation: Q2 revenue NT$9.0 billion (up 21% YoY); H1 revenue NT$1.7 billion (up 15% YoY), mainly thanks to higher contribution from automation products.
9. Note: The Electromechanical Systems and Power & Energy groups together account for more than 70% of total company revenue.
10. Three major market trends

11. United States: Continued capital inflow from CSP operators is boosting power‑related demand. Gas‑pipeline, infrastructure firms and data‑centers are seeing strong demand, driving large‑motor orders up nearly 30% YoY for Jan‑Jul. TECO is actively positioning transformers, distribution panels and other power equipment, and building new plants worldwide to capture orders.

12. Taiwan: The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ high‑consumption‑user diagnostics and energy‑saving program is creating opportunities for chiller replacement, motor upgrades and AI‑based smart energy‑management platforms. Solar power and storage installations in Jan‑Jul also outperformed the same period last year.
13. Southeast Asia: Data‑center markets in Southeast Asia—especially Malaysia and Thailand—continue to grow, generating demand for M&E (mechanical & electrical) engineering and customized solutions.
14. Four strategic focus areas and future layout

15. Green energy and storage: Pursuing the second offshore wind project and Taipower’s Shen‑Ao power plant project; the Australia solar‑plus‑storage project is slated for installation testing in Q4 and revenue contribution thereafter; domestic‑made PCS has entered mass production; TECO has secured 30 MW of green‑power supply capacity.

16. Electrification and electric vehicles (EV/ drones): Launched a transformer plant project in Indonesia and is targeting the U.S. transformer supply list; collaborating with an Indian customer to develop a new commercial‑vehicle electric drive axle and has won a mining‑truck power‑system order; completed development of a heavy‑load drone system and supplied units for testing by U.S. customers.
17. Energy‑saving and product‑line expansion: Phase‑5 HVAC plant is advancing construction to capture large‑chiller opportunities.

18. Key regions and Data Centers: Established a president‑direct‑managed subsidiary to aggressively pursue petrochemical and new‑environment opportunities; simultaneously expanding into Taiwan, Japan and Southeast Asian data‑center markets; the modular data‑center (MDC) proof‑of‑concept is expected to be built in Q4.
19. Full Q&A list from the TECO earnings call
20. Q1: How much business does Taiwan’s mandatory “>800 kW large‑user” diagnostics policy generate?

21. A: The threshold has expanded from about 490 large users to roughly 5,000 users (including malls and SMEs) and is now mandatory. TECO’s ESCO experience, combined with its “TECO‑Info” service, can handle carbon inventory, reporting, diagnostics and equipment optimization, opening up replacement opportunities for chillers, air‑compressors, water pumps and other energy‑saving gear, and can replicate its success with the biggest users to smaller ones.
22. Q2: What is the status of the air‑conditioning business transformation and the outlook for commercial air‑conditioning (B2B)?

23. A: The overall decline in the first half was driven by the residential (B2C) market, but high‑margin commercial large‑scale air‑conditioning (B2B) achieved double‑digit growth (over 25%). TECO focuses on large‑scale commercial energy‑saving air‑conditioning for electronics factories (energy savings of 30‑40%), offering multi‑unit chain control and central control systems. Demand for very large units (up to 1,600 tons) is strong, improving product mix and gross margin dramatically; revenue and profit are expected to keep improving.
24. Q3: U.S. large‑motor orders for Jan‑Jul grew almost 30% YoY; what drove this surge?

25. A: Large‑air‑conditioning customers of Tecco‑Westinghouse in the U.S. are repurposing equipment for data‑centers, causing a sharp rise in medium‑ and high‑voltage motor demand with large order sizes placed ahead of schedule. In addition, high oil prices have prompted oil companies to restart extraction, spurring a boom in demand for 800‑1,000 hp HPOP motors.
26. Q4: Latest progress on green‑power and power‑sale business and market supply‑demand conditions?

27. A: TECO has signed its first long‑term green‑power supply contract with a large, stable‑purchase customer, and a second order from a major Taiwanese supply‑chain player is close to finalization. The green‑power market is currently tight, with prices rising steadily. TECO will accelerate support for Taiwanese firms to build solar and storage facilities and provide downstream supply.
28. Q5: Order and shipment schedule for the new Malaysia busway plant?

29. A: The first order was received at the end of July, with shipments expected to start between late September and October. The factory features high automation and laser control, with coating and process standards above industry level, capable of delivering modular products for data‑center and Southeast Asian construction needs.
30. Q6: Verification progress of the MDC (modular data‑center) POC?

31. A: Progress is on track; the design of the first 2.7 MW MDC POC is fully completed, located in Malaysia, with construction expected to finish between late September and October, marking a key milestone for TECO in the data‑center arena.
32. Q7: What are the overall engineering advantages of Data Centers in Malaysia and Thailand?

33. A: Cloud‑service providers (CSPs) value on‑time, high‑quality delivery the most. TECO’s strong execution demonstrated by its Malaysia team has earned customer trust, enabling expansion into Thailand and other Southeast Asian countries.
34. Q8: Outlook for overall operating performance and gross‑margin of each business group for the second half of the year?

35. A: With continued shipments of high‑margin commercial air‑conditioning (B2B), U.S. large motors, Southeast Asian data‑center busways and electrification modules, combined with disciplined expense control, the second‑half gross margin is expected to stay at least at the same level as H1 or improve YoY. paras:
一、廣達(2382-TW)2026年第二季財務與營運詳情 

1. 第二季財務表現回顧
單季多項財務指標創歷史新高 ：第二季營收、毛利、營業淨利及單季EPS均創單季歷史新高。營收季增28.1%、年增105.6%，主因伺服器與筆記型電腦強勁成長。筆電出貨1150萬臺，季增15%，優於預期。毛利率5.02%，持穩，顯示AI伺服器出貨結構調整後的毛利稀釋效應已趨緩。營業利潤342億元再創新高，營業費用率降至1.72%新低。
伺服器業務強勁成長，AI佔比持續提升：伺服器與筆電營收均雙位數成長，其中伺服器增速更高，受AI與通用型伺服器驅動。AI伺服器占伺服器營收於前兩季達75%至80%，下半年將續升，並維持2026年占比80%的目標。ASP大致持平，顯示新舊產品世代轉換已完成，營收增長主要來自出貨量提升。
筆電業務毛利受壓，下半年展望保守：雖上半年筆電出貨優於預期，但受記憶體與CPU等零件短缺與漲價影響，毛利率受壓。因客戶提前備貨與成本考量，預期下半年出貨低於上半年，呈「旺季不旺」。第三季筆電出貨量估季減逾20%，全年出貨量較去年雙位數下滑。
2. 資本支出與產能擴充計畫
海內外產能擴充進度符合預期：本季資本支出136億元，上半年累計218億元，主要用於美國加州與泰國廠的AI相關產能擴充，占比逾八成。擴產進度符合預期，目標於2025年底達成產能倍增。
收購華亞廠以滿足長期AI訂單需求：董事會於7月底通過以197億元收購桃園龜山華亞廠。此舉具策略意義：一是鄰近現有研發總部與工廠，可高效銜接研發至量產；二是廠房具高電力容量，適合高階伺服器擴產。此收購為滿足延伸至2028年的AI產品訂單需求，預計2028年台灣AI伺服器後段組裝產能將較目前倍增。
上修資本支出並增資海外子公司：因客戶需求強勁，2026年資本支出自300億元上調至400億元。同時決議對德國子公司增資以擴充智慧駕駛產線，並對美國子公司增資以加碼加州AI伺服器組裝產能，合計約10億美元。
3. 第三季業務展望與策略
伺服器業務持續增長，調整交易模式：預期第三季AI伺服器營收續季增，但增幅低於第二季。為緩解營運資金壓力與毛利稀釋，已與客戶協商，將部分高單價零件之交易模式由「買賣(buy and sell)」改為「客戶供料(consignment)」。客戶分散與產品多元化亦有進展，有助優化產品組合。
車載業務逐步回溫：第二季智慧駕駛與電動車相關產品營收呈雙位數季增與年增，顯示產品組合調整完成、市場回溫。雖受AI伺服器強勁成長而稀釋其營收占比，業務團隊持續取得新專案，並規劃擴充德國廠區產能。
全年利潤率預期維持上半年水準：綜合下半年AI伺服器占比提升、產品組合優化與筆電下滑對規模經濟的不利影響，預估全年利潤率可維持上半年水準。

【廣達法說會問答完整清單(Q&A)】 

Q1：下半年的 Consignment(寄售／客供料)模式佔比與利潤走勢如何？
回答：目前 Consignment 佔比並不高，僅是一個開端(signal/start up)。這是針對特定客戶、特定專案(Project-by-project)的需求而定，並非全客戶適用。因此下半年的 Consignment 佔比確實維持在較低水準。
Q2：面對同業調升展望，廣達對 2027/2028 年的伺服器景氣怎麼看？
回答：廣達對 2027 與 2028 年的展望感到非常興奮(very exciting)。最具體的例子是公司甚至買下友達的新廠，就是為了布局 2028 年的產能(capacity)需求。
Q3：新舊 GPU 平台交替(Transition)期間，出貨量是否會受到影響？
回答：這是一個平滑(smooth)過渡的過程，量會逐漸爬升(liquid up)。中間可能會有 1 至 2 個月的過渡調整期，但理論上不會看到太大的停頓(hitup/gap)。
Q4：下半年產品價格上升，為何毛利／利潤能與上半年維持相對穩定？
回答：客戶群非常多元，買單時間點不同。公司目標是維持營業利益(OP Margin)與毛利金額(Margin dollar)的成長，而非單看毛利率(Gross Margin %)，後者容易受營收基數與產品組合影響。此外，營運槓桿(Operating Leverage)的提升也有助於支持下半年的整體獲利。
Q5：目前 NeoCloud(新興雲端)等買方的競爭態勢與產能擴充規劃？
回答： 能提供大 CSP 的 ODM 屈指可數，且 NeoCloud 客戶的規格要求不像傳統 SaaS 巨頭般僵化，整體競爭態勢對 ODM 稍微有利。產能規劃上，2026 年(今年)產能目標是實現翻倍(Double)；2028 年台灣廠區產能也希望再次翻倍。
Q6：Consignment(寄售)模式適用在哪些產品？對明年營收有何影響？
回答：ASIC 與 GPU 案子兩者皆有，針對特定的 key components(如昂貴料件)轉為 Consignment。明年 Consignment 佔比若提高會減少部分認列營收，但因下一代產品單價(ASP)大幅提高，兩相抵銷下，整體營收趨勢依然持續向上。
Q7：零組件(Memory/CPU)成本上漲，對各產品線與下半年拉貨的影響？
回答：按百分比來看，影響最大的是筆電(NB)，其次是加速器，再來才是 GPU。記憶體與 CPU 供需目前無大幅改善，消費性產品(Consumer)受影響最大，這也是下半年對消費性產品持保守態度的原因；大型 CSP 則因資源較充裕，受缺料影響相對較小。
Q8：第三季 AI 伺服器與通用型伺服器(General Server)的成長展望？
回答：出貨量(Volume)角度： 通用型伺服器(General Server)受惠於今年 CPU 需求比預期好，其出貨量成長率甚至大於 GPU 伺服器。另外，因 GPU 伺服器單價高，營收貢獻仍佔大宗。兩者在第三季皆呈現強勁成長。
Q9：廣達為何堅持專注於 CSP 直供(Direct Model)，而不透過 Enterprise 品牌廠(如 Dell/HP)切入？
回答：品牌模式中間轉手兩次利潤，對 CSP 客戶來說並不是最佳商業模式。廣達從第一天就決定全力服務 CSP 客戶，建立了最豐富的客戶群(Customer base)。若回頭做品牌代工會造成研發(R&D)內耗，因此目前沒有意願重新透過品牌廠切入。
Q10：廣達切入 NeoCloud(新興雲端)客戶的優勢與 Consignment 談判難易度？
回答：廣達的切入機會在於，很多 NeoCloud 客戶是由 GPU 主力供應商(如 Nvidia)直接引薦過來的，未來佔比與利潤空間(Margin dollar)相對較好。與傳統大型 CSP 談 Consignment 較容易，因為合作超過十年(Over a decade)、信任度高且獲利空間充足；與 NeoCloud 客戶的合作則仍處於逐步摸索與溝通的階段。

items.title_en: Ricoh's AI Summary: Q2 2026 Financial and Operating Details
paras:
一、仁寶(2324-TW)2026年第二季財務與營運詳情 

1.第二季與上半年財務表現
非個人電腦(Non-PC)業務貢獻強勁： 非 PC 營收佔比達 35%，年增 5 個百分點，持續朝向 40% 的目標邁進，主要由 AI 服務業務的加速成長所帶動。
毛利率受成本上升影響： 第二季毛利率為 4.6%，主要受零組件(尤其記憶體)成本上升的壓力所致。儘管如此，得益於持續優化與營運效率提升，毛利金額仍實現季增 4%、年增 4%。
獲利能力成長： 營業利益成長至 28 億，季增 8%、年增 9%，超越毛利的成長幅度。第二季淨利為 31 億，季增 59%，每股盈餘(EPS)為 0.73 美元(或元)，部分受惠於金融資產按市值計價的未實現利益。
上半年業績表現亮眼： 2026 年上半年淨利達 51 億，年增 91%，EPS 為 1.18 美元(或元)，反映出民用業務成長、產品組合改善以及公司轉型所帶來的效益。
資產負債表保持健康： 季末現金約為 830 億。負債比率因業務擴張微幅上升至 71%，但仍維持在健康水準。每股淨值提升至 31.3 美元(或元)。
2. 業務轉型與各部門表現
AI PC 與伺服器成長動能強勁： 公司已做好充份準備，迎接 AI PC 的換機超級週期。2026 年第一季的 AI 伺服器營收已追平 2025 全年度總和，目前佔伺服器產品組合比重超過一半。高階 AI PC 占比提升帶動了營收與毛利率雙雙成長。
非 PC 業務擴充： 非 PC 營收年增 52%，市場份額提升 5 個百分點，有望在年底前達成 40% 的目標。此成長主要由 AI 伺服器帶動，並受惠於 5G、醫療科技(Medtech)和物理 AI(Physical AI)等重點領域的貢獻。
筆記型電腦市場展望： 筆記型電腦營收季增 20%，但受限於供應鏈瓶頸，出貨量年減 13%。產品組合轉向高階與 AI PC，拉高了平均售價(ASP)。預計 2026 年下半年市場將下滑 15% 至 17%。
全球 AI 基礎設施佈局： 在歐洲、亞洲與美國接連取得 AI 雲端訂單，持續擴大成長動能。位於台灣與美國的新設施陸續啟用，提供包含整機櫃 L11 整合在內的端到端解決方案，貼近客戶需求。

【仁寶法說會問答完整清單(Q&A)】 

Q1：2027 年 PC 市場的競爭狀況與記憶體通膨策略為何？
回答：不盲目追逐低毛量的出貨規模，而是爭取更高毛利的產品線並鎖定 AI PC。上半年 AI PC 占出貨量約 50%，由於 ASP 較高，占筆電營收高達 60%。
Q2：如何因應傳統與中國 ODM 業者的價格競爭？
回答： 跳脫原本僵化的零件清單，向客戶提出引進多元供應商的替代方案來降低成本。 2025 年全球 9 國廠區的 UPPH(人均產能)提升了 28%，大幅降低營運成本，使報價(RFQ)更具競爭力。
Q3：2026 下半年 PC 市場的下滑趨勢與仁寶的表現如何？
回答：市場整體在 2026 下半年(對比 2025 下半年)預估下滑約 15%。仁寶第三季出貨相當穩定，表現具備韌性，甚至有機會奪取部分市占率。
Q4：新興雲端(Neocloud)客戶對 AI 伺服器業務的貢獻與未來組合？
回答：Q2 伺服器營收占比提升至高個位數(High Single-Digit)，其中 70% 由 AI 伺服器帶動，Neocloud 是主要成長推手。今年伺服器占總營收 10% 的目標在軌道上。展望2027 年，隨著德州與台灣新廠啟用，客戶將擴展至 Neocloud、Tier-1 超大規模雲端業者(Hyperscalers)及至少一家大型企業客戶，形成多元均衡的結構。
Q5：2026 與 2027 年的資本支出(CapEx)指引為何？
回答：2026 年 維持 180 億元 指引，上半年已支出約 90 億元(其中 60 億～70 億元用於伺服器)。2027 年尚未有具體數字，但因伺服器需求強勁，今明兩年皆為產能擴張年，下半年將持續投入台灣、越南及美國廠區。
Q6：營運費用率(OpEx Ratio)下降的原因與未來控管目標？
回答：Q2 費用率下降主要是營收擴大帶來的營業槓桿(Operating Leverage)效應。公司以「絕對金額」控管費用，上半年 OpEx 年增僅約 3%，全年的目標是將 OpEx 絕對金額的年成長率控制在個位數。
Q7：代理型 AI(Agentic AI)是否會帶動傳統伺服器的需求？
回答：目前全球建置的算力還不到未來需求的 1%。當軟體從管理 1 個代理擴展到 50～100 個持續執行的代理時，算力嚴重不足。這將帶動推理算力(Inference)、代理型算力及其他資料中心基礎設施的龐大機會。
Q8：AI 伺服器的產品型態(L6 vs. L10/L11)與世代過渡時程？
回答：從產品結構來看， 上半年 AI 伺服器營收已有 70% 來自 L10，主要為台灣生產的 B300。針對產品迭代，產品世代交替極快且無停滯或重疊，B300 強勁需求將貫穿 2026 全年，隨著新 CPU 加入，將迅速過渡至下一代平台。大型機櫃(如 NVL72)預計於 2027 年 Q1 開始爬坡量產。
Q9：2027 年伺服器營收目標與 PC 占營收比重變化？
回答： 預計 2027 年伺服器業務(主要為 AI 伺服器)將佔總營收的 30%～40%。隨著伺服器、車用、醫療及智慧裝置的快速成長，PC 占公司總營收比重確實將降至 50% 以下，仁寶正式轉型為多元化的 ODM 業者。
Q10：面對伺服器快速擴張，公司的資金籌措與財務結構規劃為何？
回答：現狀健康，目前負債比率為 71%(優於同業平均)，且擁有充裕的銀行融資額度(Bank Facility)，營運現金流足以支持當前成長。 針對未來龐大的機櫃級(Rack-scale)資金需求，公司對海外可轉債(ECB)或股權增資 持開放態度，將視業務推進狀況彈性評估。

paras_en: I. Ricoh (2324-TW) Q2 2026 Financial and Operating Details
1. Q2 and H1 Financial Performance

Non-PC business contributed strongly: Non-PC revenue accounted for 35% of total revenue, up 5 percentage points year-over-year, and continued to move towards the 40% target, mainly driven by the acceleration of AI service business.

Gross margin affected by cost increases: The gross margin was 4.6% in Q2, mainly due to the pressure of rising component costs, particularly memory.
